description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mudduwa, Ratnapura D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620278
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications) in various locations within Ratnapura District. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration, which squarely fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
